text: あしを　つよく　けって　あいてを　ころばせて　こうげきする。

structure.jp: あしを　つよく　けって
あいてを　ころばせて
structure.en: makes the foe fall over and

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: This verb shape says you make someone do something. ころぶ 'fall over' becomes ころばせる. ころばせて = 'making it fall over'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, here showing how the attack is done. あしを　つよく　けって = 'kicking the legs hard, and'.

patterns.name: 〜く (adverb)
patterns.explanation: An い-word changed to く tells how an action is done. つよく　けって = 'kicking hard'.
